title: Works okay
text: Works okay. I think these worked okay. there definitely could be better designs with these. It's definitely going to depend on what type of cords you have and how much length of them. Basically you just stuff the cords into them. The thing is, the way it is designed it is possible for it to come out. Also, because of the way it is, I think this would be easier for kids to figure out than some of the other safety products out there. They are a good value, but it does come with a price of a bit of functionality. No matter what, it is very important to keep cords out of kids' reach.

product_metadata.title: Home Safe by Summer Blind Cord Fastener, 2-Pack
features: The package weight of the product is 1 pounds
description: Use Home Safe Blind Cord Shorteners to help keep dangling blind cords safely away from your child or pet. The simple pouch design is easy to use. Wind blind cords to desired length, squeeze the shortener open, and place bundle inside to secure excess cords.
